applicant.name: Prof. Daniel Aigner
applicant.organisation: Department of Trauma Surgery, medical university

purpose: Research on orthogeriatric care to decide where to place fracture liaison services.
question: How many inpatient stays for hip fracture were there from 2023 to 2025 in each hospital, and how many of them were of patients aged 65 or older?
definitions: Hip fracture stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with S72.
Count stays (not patients) with a start_date from 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2025, per hospital (data_holder of the stay).
Report per hospital: hip fracture stays, stays of patients aged 65 or older, and their share of all hip fracture stays in %, one decimal.
